content.short: DALPS sits on top of wallets, providing a rewards credit card and an integrated marketplace for digital and retail rewards.
content.description: DALPS reimagines loyalty and rewards by leveraging blockchain and NFTs to ensure digital offers are secure, transparent, and verifiable. Users can effortlessly claim, store, and redeem rewards ranging from retail discounts to digital assets within a single marketplace. For businesses, the platform streamlines the creation and distribution of digital offers, increasing trust and engagement with customers while simplifying program management.
content.meta: DALPS layers over wallets to offer a rewards card and a marketplace for digital and retail rewards. Discover DALPS and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
